display.purpose: Home hero line (46/72/92px) and the interlude statement (40/64/80px). Balanced wrap, about 14 to 17ch.

headline.purpose: Public section headings, the workspace current-milestone title, the staff case title.

title.purpose: Workspace section heads, stage names, article titles in lists, next-action text.

body.purpose: Lead paragraphs (36 to 52ch) and article bodies (66ch).

label.purpose: Status words, row-head labels, hints, meta lines, draft notes. Sentence case, never uppercase.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Surfaces never cast shadows; depth is a ground change plus a hairline.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Field focus halo only, paired with a pool-blue border.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Defined in the theme but intentionally unused. Do not apply.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and button press.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour transitions on controls.

motion.name: ripple-in
motion.value: 6px rise, 4px blur to clear, scroll-timeline entry 0% to 55%
motion.purpose: Sections settle in as they enter, where view timelines exist; Navigator answers arrive with it at 600ms.

motion.name: still-water
motion.value: WebGL caustic, time scale 0.16, halves under the pointer
motion.purpose: Ambient light layer behind the home hero and interlude, inner public title bands, and the sign-in panel. One still frame under reduced motion; static radial wash without WebGL.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
Beacon is a pale pool seen from above on a calm day: white and light-blue ground, deep ink-blue type, and slow refracted light drifting across the floor. The light is the only atmosphere. On the public site a WebGL caustic layer sits behind the home hero and interlude and under the title band of inner pages; everywhere else the page is flat, open, and divided by hairline rules. People who arrive here are anxious and often on a phone, so the system stays quiet, the type is large, and nothing competes with the next step.

One typeface (Manrope) does all the work, from a 92px centred display line to 13px status labels. Sections are open bands on the canvas or on white, separated by single hairlines. White panels with a hairline border are reserved for things people act on or read closely: a Navigator answer, a form, a release control. The working screens (workspace, staff console) inherit the same world without the water; they are denser but use the same tokens, the same rows, and the same status language.

The build refuses the family-law default of stock photography, a navy header bar, and three feature cards.
keyCharacteristics: Light blue and white ground, deep ink-blue type, one pool-blue accent.
Caustic light as the only atmospheric device; no drop shadows on surfaces.
Manrope throughout, medium-weight display with tight negative tracking.
Hairline rules and open bands instead of boxed cards.
One five-column label grid for every checklist and document row.
Status is always an icon plus a word.

rules.name: The One Accent, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Pool blue means "act here" or "you are here" and nothing else. It never decorates a heading, a section band, or an icon that is not an action. Completed steps are ink, not blue.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Brick red appears only for safety, destructive actions, and errors. It is never a brand colour and never a second accent.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. No uppercase eyebrows or tracked labels above them; context goes in a muted sentence below.

rules.name: The One Label Grid Rule
rules.body: Every checklist and document row uses the same grid: item, status, owner, date, action (flexible, 140px, 130px, 110px, 128px) from 768px, with a 13px muted column-head row above it on a strong hairline. Below 768px it collapses to item plus status, with owner and date folded into a muted meta line and the action spanning full width.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: To lift something, change its ground (canvas to white, or white to pale pool) or give it a hairline. Do not add a box-shadow. The only gradients are the caustic layer and its static fallback wash.

rules.name: The Still Water Rule
rules.body: The caustic layer appears only on public and sign-in surfaces: full-bleed behind the home hero and interlude, as a title band at the top of inner public pages and articles, and as the sign-in side panel. Never behind working screens. It drifts slowly, slows and brightens under the pointer, renders one still frame under reduced motion, and falls back to a soft radial wash without WebGL.

dos: Do keep pool blue for actions and the current milestone only.
Do keep brick red for safety, destructive actions, and errors only.
Do pair every status with its icon and word.
Do put every checklist and document row on the one five-column label grid with a 13px muted head row.
Do separate sections with a single hairline and a ground change (canvas to white), padded 96 to 128px.
Do use white hairline panels (18px) only for things people act on or read closely.
Do keep the safety link reachable from every public view.
Do honour reduced motion: the water holds one still frame and reveals stop.
donts: Don't add box-shadows to cards, panels, or menus; lift with ground and hairline instead.
Don't use gradients outside the caustic layer and its fallback wash.
Don't put the caustic layer behind workspace or staff screens.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or tracked labels above headings.
Don't colour status words or render status as coloured pills.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a second accent colour.
Don't use stock family photography, a navy header bar, or a row of three feature cards.
